Mexico — Maradona's tournament.

How 1986 FIFA World Cup connects

  • Character: Diego Maradona — Maradona made the 1986 World Cup his personal tournament.
  • Event: Hand of God — The Hand of God happened in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final.
  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — The 1986 tournament is Maradona's World Cup.

What is 1986 FIFA World Cup?

The 1986 World Cup in Mexico is Maradona's: the quarter-final against England, the final against West Germany, and Argentina's second title.
